message.content:
A magazine cover for "TEMPO" dated "16-22 MARET 2020" features a vertical red border on the left. The background is red on the left and dark green on the right. A massive, green, globular creature with rounded protrusions and a textured surface occupies the right half. A man in a white collared shirt stands on the left, leaning against the creature with his left elbow. He has his right arm raised, pointing a finger at a small indentation on the creature's side. The man's eyes are closed, and he has a slight smile. 

Numerous smaller, stylized virus-like orbs with spike-like projections float across the top and down the left side. These orbs are colored pink, light green, and yellow-green. Some appear to be emerging from a jagged, torn opening in the top of the giant green creature. 

Large white block letters in the center read "COMPANG CAMPING CORONA." Below this, smaller white text states, "WABAH COVID-19 MEMASUKI FASE KRITIS. STRATEGI MITIGASI PRESIDEN JOKOWI BISA MEMPERBURUK SITUASI." Other text at the top includes "WAWANCARA KHUSUS MAHATHIR MOHAMAD" and "LOBI-LOBI OMNIBUS LAW." A QR code and barcode are at the bottom.
